description: Add or change a Greenhouse database table end to end: core tables in packages/db (schema with _columns helpers + ids prefix, domain service, provider registration, drizzle-kit generate into packages/db/migrations, pnpm db:migrate, db-schema.md, *.db.test.ts) or plugin tables in plugins/<id> (own schema, service bag, NNNN_name.sql lane file). Use for: add a table / column / migration / service, 新增表, 加个表, 建张表, 加字段要迁移, 写个 service. Red lines: migrate never push, never edit an applied migration, no repository classes or interface mirrors, types are inferred, core never gets plugin tables or plugin FKs.
